title: December 27 Muzrabot electricity-road protest reported in a January 2 article
notes: The January 2 NOVA24 article dates a road action by residents of mahalla Obi Hayot, Muzrabot District, to December 27. It says electricity was restored that day, but does not say when the crowd left or whether any physical gathering continued into January. This is prior-month boundary context only, not a January candidate or proof of a continuous episode.

title: Kokand gas-and-electricity road-blockade lead; video circulated Dec. 28, physical date unknown
notes: Podrobno published Dec. 29 and says video of women blocking the road to Kokand city hokimiyat circulated the previous day, Dec. 28; video circulation does not establish the physical action date. The report identifies Vakf Chorsu and the utility grievance. No crowd count or physical departure is reported, and no January presence is established. UzNews S162 describes the same detailed event/official response but its own publication date is unavailable; the pair is not counted as independent corroboration. This is earlier-month context with physical date unresolved, not a January candidate.

title: Shargiron, Bukhara gas grievance and attempted road block; physical date unknown
notes: Kun.uz published its report on Dec. 10, 2020 and describes social-media video of Shargiron mahalla residents voicing gas-supply grievances and attempting to block a street; the article does not date the physical action or video circulation. It reports a meeting/hearing by Hududgaz Bukhara staff and regional hokimiyat/sector heads, an attributed pressure problem and supply restoration underway. It does not quantify the crowd, confirm a completed road block or report a physical end. The report date is not used as the action date. No January presence is established, and physical episode ownership remains pending.
